why: P2 because it improves Guix release-build integrity by removing internal build paths from shipped binaries, some of which (Qt prefix, xkb config path, icon path) could otherwise cause wrong runtime behavior on user systems, not just leak debug info.

result.summary: This PR patches the Guix release build so that resulting binaries no longer embed filesystem paths pointing into the /bitcoin/depends build directory, covering both compiler debug-info prefix maps and runtime defaults baked into Qt, libxkbcommon, and libxcb-util-cursor. It also adds a symbol-check.py test (check_no_depends) that scans built binaries for any remaining '/bitcoin/depends/' string, to prevent regressions. The author notes uncertainty about the right approach for some of the Qt sub-dependency patches.
result.problem: Release binaries built through Guix currently embed hardcoded references to the depends build directory (e.g. in debug symbols and in default XKB/icon search paths), which is meaningless or actively wrong once the binary runs on a user's machine, since that path does not exist there.

open_concerns: Author is not fully confident about the correct approach for the Qt and sub-dependency path patches and has left this open for discussion.

result.card: This PR (fanquake, draft) removes references to the internal /bitcoin/depends build directory from Guix-built release binaries, covering both debug-symbol prefix maps and runtime path defaults for Qt, libxkbcommon, and libxcb-util-cursor, and adds a symbol-check.py test to guard against regressions.
